name: Sliding Puzzle
description: Interactive sliding image puzzle section with a draggable tile grid next to an intro column with title, stats and a reset button, over a soft blurred blob background.
contents: Stats row with grid size, piece count and infinity moves
Grid of draggable image tiles with one empty cell
behavior: Tiles next to the empty cell can be dragged into it and snap to the grid
Reset button returns all tiles to their start positions once a move has been made
GSAP Draggable is loaded by dynamic import and cleaned up on unmount
Two columns on tablet and desktop, stacked on mobile

props.name: subheading
props.default: Discover the image by moving the pieces one by one.

editableByProps: All text labels, heading and subheading
Tile images, grid size, padding and radius
Swap duration and drop overlap threshold
Background, text, muted, accent, button and blob colors
fixed: Pieces array length must equal gridSize * gridSize - 1
Empty cell is always top-left and tiles start in solved order, not shuffled
Tile size is measured once on mount and is not recalculated on window resize
Section is at least one viewport tall
